text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hi! What's up, Ace? You look pretty 
exhausted!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's my birthday today, after all! I just 
got back from running a lap around the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's a personal rule of mine. One is: 
"Every year on my birthday, run a full 
sprint around the academy and time it!"â

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The other is: "Definitely beat last year's 
time"!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely gonna be stronger than I 
was last year! A birthday is the perfect 
milestone for that kind of thing, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Whew, awesome! That's the Ace I know!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Coming "here" to see you was 
definitely the right call!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh? Tap, did you need something from me?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hm? Nah, it's no big deal at all!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Ace of Japan. —Just 
wanted to say that!"
